review_method: Every occupied cell was inspected from the original-resolution outcome-group contact sheet. These notes describe post-signal paths only and do not rewrite Phase-1 morphology.

PROFIT_0_TO_4PCT.bucket_observation: The small-profit paths are heterogeneous. Many H20 exits occur near flat after a choppy holding interval, and post-H20 continuation varies in both directions. No exclusive signal-time candle prototype is visible.
PROFIT_0_TO_4PCT.counterexample_observation: Both visually strong and visibly damaged Phase-1 structures occur in the small-profit group; neither is sufficient to identify a clean acceptance path.

SEVERE_LOSS.bucket_observation: Severe losses usually reject the signal during the early part of the frozen holding window and are near a local low around the H20 exit. A material subset repairs only after H20, so merely extending the hold would exchange realized loss for deeper path drawdown and is not supported by this review.
SEVERE_LOSS.counterexample_observation: Terminal surges and mature advances are common among some severe losses, but the same Phase-1 appearances also occur among fast winners. Static pre-signal appearance alone does not separate them.

NO_COMPLETED_TRADE.bucket_observation: The eight paths were visually inspected, but their frozen lifecycle is unobservable because no legal entry or valid coordinate-continuous completed trade exists.
NO_COMPLETED_TRADE.counterexample_observation: No return inference is assigned to an unexecuted or invalid-lineage path.

aggregate.dominant_observation: The clearest outcome-side distinction is rapid post-entry acceptance versus early rejection, not a unique signal-time candle shape.
